  (m k : Nat) (wp wn : Matrix.{0, 0, 0} (Fin k) (Fin n) Real) (gate : Fin k → Bool)
  (tail : HiddenMonotonicity.MaskedTrace k m) (α : Nat → Real) (seed : HiddenMonotonicity.Sensitivity m)
  (h_1 :
    (α : Nat → Real) →
      (seed : HiddenMonotonicity.Sensitivity n) → motive n (HiddenMonotonicity.MaskedTrace.output n) α seed)
  (h_2 :
    (m k : Nat) →
      (wp wn : Matrix.{0, 0, 0} (Fin k) (Fin n) Real) →
        (gate : Fin k → Bool) →
          (tail : HiddenMonotonicity.MaskedTrace k m) →
            (α : Nat → Real) →
              (seed : HiddenMonotonicity.Sensitivity m) →
                motive m (@HiddenMonotonicity.MaskedTrace.layer n k m wp wn gate tail) α seed),
  @Eq.{u_1} (motive m (@HiddenMonotonicity.MaskedTrace.layer n k m wp wn gate tail) α seed)
    (@HiddenMonotonicity.MaskedTrace.run.match_1.{u_1} n motive m
      (@HiddenMonotonicity.MaskedTrace.layer n k m wp wn gate tail) α seed h_1 h_2)
    (h_2 m k wp wn gate tail α seed)
